About Us

A calm, personal way to learn the Qur'an

"Better Qur'an Readers, A Stronger Ummah."
Al-Arabiyah Learning Center — Learn · Practice · Grow

Al-Arabiyah Learning Center is an online Qur'an education institute dedicated to helping children of Bangladeshi families living around the world learn, recite and understand the Holy Qur'an with confidence.

Founded in 2021, we've grown into a community of over 3,500 families. We provide live, one-to-one online Qur'an classes with qualified and dedicated teachers — each student receives personalized attention based on their age, current Qur'an level, and learning needs.

Our mission is simple: to help every child develop correct Qur'an reading skills, build a strong connection with the Qur'an, and grow with essential Islamic knowledge.

Courses

Choose the path that fits your child

Every course is taught one-to-one and paced to the student — beginner or advanced.

Qur'an Reading with Tajweed

Learn to read the Holy Qur'an correctly with proper pronunciation and essential Tajweed rules. Students receive guided practice to improve their recitation step by step.

1-to-1 · All ages

Basic Islamic Knowledge

Age-appropriate lessons covering essential Islamic beliefs, practices, duas and everyday Islamic knowledge for children and beginners.

1-to-1 · Kids & teens

Personalized Qur'an Course

Every learner is different. Our teachers assess each student's level and provide a personalized learning plan according to their needs and goals.

1-to-1 · Custom plan

Inside a Class

Real Teachers, Real Classes, Real Connection

Meet Your Teacher

Learn from someone who lived this journey himself

Hamzah Tamim

Qur'an & Arabic Teacher · Hafiz-ul-Qur'an · Online & Offline Educator

80+Students Taught
Since 2016Offline Teaching
Since 2018Online Teaching
Ages 4–70+Students Taught

Hamzah Tamim is a dedicated Qur'an & Arabic teacher and Hafiz-ul-Qur'an. His own Qur'an journey began at Sowtul Qur'an Academy, Rajshahi, where he studied from the very basics, completed his Hifz-ul-Qur'an, and received Nurani Training — the same foundation he now builds his teaching on.

He began teaching offline in 2016, and moved online in 2018 — opening the door to students far beyond Bangladesh. Since then he has taught 80+ students, aged 4 to 70+, adapting his approach to every age, level, and background.

"I believe students learn better when they are taught with patience, encouragement, and proper guidance — rather than pressure."
